§6Laser Isotope Separation Chamber (SILEX)§f

§aThe upgrade to gas centrifuges. Separates isotopes with lasers instead of spinning.§f

The SILEX separates isotopes via laser excitation. It needs a §bFEL§f nearby to operate. Unlike the Gas Centrifuge, it can process materials in liquid, powder, or compound form.

Crafted in the Assembly Factory: 16 Quartz Glass, 8 Triple Steel Plate, 4 Workers Alloy Ingot, 8 Rubber Bar, 8 Steel Pipe.

Inputs: liquids (UF6, PuF6) or powders liquified with §bHydrogen Peroxide§f. Output goes into the right-side slots.

Processable materials: UF6, PuF6, Lapis Lazuli (into sulfur, aluminium, cobalt), Spent RBMK Fuel, and Schraranium.

§ePS:§f The SILEX skips a step compared to gas centrifuges. One FEL powers up to §e5§f SILEX units. Place concrete between them and your base to block the laser beam.
